The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different models. The x-axis is labeled “Training Time (s)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250000, with tick labels at intervals of 50000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. A purple line, labeled “Vanilla”, is plotted with triangular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately 2.72 at x=0 and decreases to approximately 2.51 at x=250000. A red line, labeled “SepLLM”, is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately 2.71 at x=0 and decreases to approximately 2.50 at x=250000.
